deadline.value: Application must be complete by December 15, 2026 for fall 2027 admission.
deadline.quote: For full consideration for fall admission of the next year, your application should be complete by December 15.

gre_subject.value: The Subject GRE in physics is optional.
gre_subject.quote: The Graduate Record Examination Subject Test in physics is optional.

supervisor.value: The pages checked do not say whether a faculty sponsor is needed before admission.

funding.value: Most students are funded: about 65% hold teaching assistantships and 35% research assistantships, with $32,000 a year and full tuition remission.
funding.quote: Approximately 65% of our graduate students have Teaching Assistantships and 35% have Research Assistantships.

also.quote: Financial aid, including $32,000 per year Teaching or Research Assistantships (starting Fall 2025), full tuition remission, and subsidized health insurance is available to qualified applicants.

entry_route.value: Admission to major graduate study rests on undergraduate physics and math coursework, so a bachelor's degree is enough.
entry_route.quote: Thirty-two semester hours of undergraduate physics, including six semester hours of 4000-level courses in physics.

also.quote: Graduate School applicants must hold a bachelor's or equivalent professional degree.

notes: Umbrella program: the Graduate School lists one 'Physics & Astronomy Ph.D.'. The department FAQ answers on GRE, fees and English tests are collapsed on the cached page and were not quoted.
name: Physics and Astronomy, Ph.D.
